Какие форматы документов можно перевести: Which document formats can be translated?
Word (.docx), PDF, Excel, PowerPoint, HT: Word (.docx), PDF, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, text files, images and scans. Every format is first converted to .docx, translated, and then returned: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and text files in their own format, a PDF with a text layer as a PDF, scans and images with their captions redrawn. Whatever is lost on the way back is stated on the file before you pay.
Сохранится ли оформление документа?: Will the document layout be preserved?
Да. Перевод пишется в исходный файл, а н: Yes. The translation is written into the original file rather than assembled from scratch: styles, tables, figures, headers and the table of contents stay in place, and Word recomputes the page numbers. Captions inside images are read separately and painted over the image when the background is uniform; otherwise the translation becomes a caption beneath it.
Как проверяется, что перевод точный?: How is the translation checked for accuracy?
Три проверки на каждой строке. Обратный: Three checks on every line. The back-translation: the text is translated back by a different model and compared with the source. Numbers, units, ranges and negations are compared without a model, and a discrepancy of that kind outweighs any opinion. Terms are checked against the glossary, and on the Pro plan a second model reads the whole pair. Whatever fails ends up in a list of questions instead of hiding inside a finished file.
Нужно ли знать язык перевода, чтобы пров: Do I need to know the target language to check the result?
Нет. Сервис показывает, что читается обр: No. The service shows you what reads back out of the translation, in your own language, and highlights the differences from the source on both sides. You are not asked to judge the translation itself: you only answer questions that are written in a language you know. A disputed line can be handed to a teammate who does know the language.
Как считается страница и цена?: How are a page and the price calculated?
Страница — 250 слов исходника, одна норм: A page is 250 words of the source, one standard for every language; for scripts without spaces (Chinese, Japanese) characters are counted instead. The estimate is calculated from the file before the upload and then fixed: how many pages, at what price, and the total. Uploading the same file again for the same language pair is not charged. The price is from $0.5 per page on Start and $0.9 on Pro.
Текст документа уходит поставщику языков: The text of the document is sent to the language model provider (OpenAI, USA) for translation and checks; this is stated plainly in the privacy policy. Files are stored inside your own organisation and are not available to other customers of the service. A project can be deleted together with its files and exports at any time.
На какие языки переводите?: Which languages do you translate into?
На любую пару из каталога языков сервиса: Into any pair from the service language catalogue: Russian, Uzbek, English, German, Spanish, French, Chinese and others. The interface is available in Russian, Uzbek and English. If some of the checks stay silent for a given pair, the service says so in advance instead of showing an invented score.
Сколько времени занимает перевод?: How long does a translation take?
Перевод и проверки идут на сервере без в: Translation and the checks run on the server without you: a 10-page article is ready in minutes, a 300-page textbook in hours rather than weeks. You can close the tab: the run continues on the server, and the result waits in the project together with a list of questions, if any came up.
